summary: Contributor contract: delete before adding. Fix root causes by removing or simplifying the code at fault rather than layering guards, flags or wrappers on top; prefer the fix that leaves the codebase smaller; remove code, tests and docs a change makes dead in the same change, after tracing callers; report unrelated dead code instead of widening the change. Decision: project owner, 2026-09-22. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Contributor working rule only; no operator-visible behavior changes.

api.reason: Contributor instructions only; no Controller or Core contract is involved.

roadmap.reason: Working-rule clarification; no phase scope change.

state.reason: Documentation-only change with no product state.
